summary: Accepted. Thirteen of the fourteen round-1 issues are fixed properly. The sequences now build on the place or the player (desk, shelf, stool, chalk), Lyra's respect line is gated on rel(lyra) >= 20, Gerald and the dummy's name are gone, the openings vary, 'Forger' replaces the second 'saint', the zh uses 还行, and the crossing is a feat challenge. One fix is incomplete: the courtyard_quotes say still counts issues. What remains is polish. Three says refer to a detail from only one random text line, two sequences use stock openings, and the tavern has an unnamed hedge-witch. None of it touches canon, safety, class rules or plot. These are one-line fixes, so the issue count (7 of 32 events) doesn't justify a rejection.

issues.problem: Left over from round 1. The random right-option say 'It's also the third issue running in which the courtyard has been represented by the same person' still claims history, and it can come up on the first showing.
issues.fix: Drop the count: 'It's quick. It's also the courtyard as represented by one person in several scarves.' Or move the count into a sequence. Update the zh to match.

issues.problem: Random picks are independent. The say 'You sew the tall dummy's arm on slightly backwards' assumes the missing arm, which is only one of three text alternatives. The other two have a scorched dummy or a painted name.
issues.fix: Write 'You sew one dummy's arm on slightly backwards. It looks more dangerous for it.' The zh line needs the same change.

issues.problem: Random picks are independent. The say 'even the sock' assumes text alternative 1. The other two (the crossword letter, the lemon-juice tip) have no sock.
issues.fix: Write 'even the ones that weren't really letters' instead, and update the zh.

issues.problem: Random picks are independent. The say 'The corridor goes on the map' doesn't fit 'The stair under the clock'.
issues.fix: Write 'It goes on the map.' or 'The passage goes on the map.'

issues.problem: Sequence lines 2 and 3 both open with 'Drawer check.', which is a stock ladder. The left label 'Open the stuck drawer' fits only showing 1, since lines 2 and 3 mention no stuck drawer.
issues.fix: Vary the openings ('A different row today…', 'Your row for the week…'), and either relabel the left option 'Open the odd drawer' or add a stuck drawer to every line.

issues.problem: Sequence lines 2 and 3 both open with 'The rush.', which is a stock ladder.
issues.fix: Vary them, for example 'Half past seven, and the door won't stay shut.' / 'The regulars just point now…'.

issues.problem: 'The hedge-witch wants her pie warmed' reads as Old Maud. The worldbook's only hedge-witch is Maud, and here she appears unnamed and out of character.
issues.fix: Make her 'the herb-wife from the lane' (or another unnamed trade), or call her Maud and say 'dearie'. Update the scene line to match.
